niche: Freelance web designer, Webflow and WordPress sites for small local businesses
price: roughly $3,500, plus a $150 a month care plan
want: Local service businesses (restaurants, salons, clinics, home services, contractors) and referral partners who already serve them (marketing agencies without an in house developer, photographers, bookkeepers, coworking spaces)
assumptions: Austin includes the close suburbs, because Cedar Park had the most new business openings on any calendar I read. Plan minutes count time on site or at the keyboard, not driving. Individual names are left out of this example, so drafts greet people with "Hi there".
intro: I build websites for restaurants, salons and contractors around Austin.
